Research notes

  • Official websites: Rawneeded, AB CHEM, BMS Pharma, EVA Pharma and pharmaconex-exhibition.com.
  • Official social pages: the Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube links shown on each card.
  • Meta Ad Library observations: what was visible during the research check. No visible results does not prove a company has no paid advertising on Meta or other platforms.
  • Public research: the KF task brief and public-source desk research.
  • AI-assisted synthesis: ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini assisted with synthesis and structure.
  • Sources: KF task brief, Rawneeded and competitor websites and social channels, Meta and LinkedIn Ad Libraries (what was visible at the time of research), pharmaconex-exhibition.com.
  • BMS Pharma's own pages give its founding as 2008 and 2009. Its site emphasises own-brand supplements and partner brands; contract manufacturing and private-label capabilities come from the project research.
  • LinkedIn links on the AB CHEM and BMS websites look like personal-style profile links. AB CHEM also has an X/Twitter account.
  • EVA Pharma figures are company-reported; its pages differ slightly on some counts.
